name: 1539-multiimage-llavaov05b-1gpu
model: lmms-lab/llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov. Public on HuggingFace, ungated, ~1.8 GB.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
architecture: LlavaQwenForCausalLM: a Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct language model (bf16) under a google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384 vision tower (fp16), mm_patch_merge_type `spatial_unpad`.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: One chat message carrying a fixed 24-token question and TEN 2048x2048 `gradient` JPEGs at quality 90, each emitted by its own `synthetic_image` dataset so that all ten arrive as `image_url` parts of the same turn. Fixed 32-token generation, greedy, seed 42.
purpose: A small vision chat assistant answering one brief question about ten high-resolution images for four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is not read, and the
# engine then runs without the setting this file declares.

model-path: lmms-lab/llava-onevision-qwen2-0.5b-ov

# The conversation format this checkpoint was trained with, pinned rather than auto-detected.
chat-template: chatml-llava

tp-size: 1

# REQUIRED. The checkpoint ships `image_aspect_ratio: "anyres_max_9"`; without this override a
# request carrying several images dies on an uncaught IndexError in the model's feature write-back.
json-model-override-args: {"image_aspect_ratio": "pad"}

# REQUIRED. At the default 8192 a co-admitted ~7.3k-token request is split mid-prefill and its
# images land in a slice of the wrong length. -1 disables chunking; `max-prefill-tokens` stays
# at its default 16384.
chunked-prefill-size: -1

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
